eligibility_rationale: Herbivory and ramet density are upstream contexts that alter floral VOC emission; the study does not estimate antagonist response to the same VOC coordinate alongside pollinator response on a paired functional geometry.
Flowering rank/synchrony is one declared phenology coordinate linked to pollinator limitation, flower/seed predation and fruit production across four subpopulations and two years.

Dissertation contains multiple primary experiments, floral traits, mutualists and floral antagonists; record-level evidence is biologically relevant but requires chapter- and trait-axis decomposition before a same-coordinate H1 claim.
